blocks.text: Molecular orbital tareeqa covalent bonding ke liye quantum mechanical hisabat ke nataij samjhata hai. Is ke mafroozat yeh hain.

items: Molecule banne ke dauran milne wale atoms ke atomic orbitals overlap kar ke naye orbitals banate hain jinhen molecular orbitals kehte hain, jo poore molecule ke hote hain.
Atomic orbitals orbital ke wave function ke munasib nishan (sign) wale lobe se overlap karte hain; p orbital ke ek lobe ko + aur doosre ko - nishan diya jata hai.

Do atomic orbitals overlap kar ke do molecular orbitals banate hain. Jab ek jaise nishan ke orbitals overlap karein to bonding molecular orbital (sigma ya pi) banta hai, jis ki energy asal atomic orbitals se kam hai; mukhalif nishanon se zyada energy wala antibonding molecular orbital (sigma* ya pi*) banta hai, jis ki energy asal atomic orbitals se zyada hai.
Overlap ke baad do atoms ke darmiyan bonds ki tadaad bond order hai, jo bonding electrons (a) aur antibonding electrons (b) ki tadaad ke farq ka aadha hai: bond order = (a - b) / 2.

blocks.text: H2 ke banne mein do s orbitals mil kar do molecular orbitals dete hain. Bonding molecular orbital sigma 1s nuclei ko milane wale mehwar (nuclear mehwar) ke gird mutawazan hai, jabke antibonding orbital sigma* 1s ki electron density overlap karne wale atoms ke nuclei se door hai.

blocks.alt: (a) Energy Diagram: oopar ki taraf Energy teer; baen aur daen H 1s, har ek mein ek electron; oopar sigma* 1s (khaali) aur neeche sigma 1s mein H2 ke do ulte teer. (b) Electron Probability Distribution: MO2, sigma* 1s antibonding molecular orbital, dono nuclei ke gird do alag lobes; MO1, sigma 1s bonding molecular orbital, dono nuclei ko gherta ek oval.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.34: H2 molecule ke liye bonding aur anti-bonding orbitals ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.34 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Seedha samne se (head-on) aana: dono atoms ke p orbitals ek hi mehwar (maslan x mehwar) par qareeb aate hain, jo sigma 2px bonding aur sigma* 2px antibonding molecular orbitals deta hai. Pehlu se (sideways) aana: jab do p orbitals (py ya pz) ke mehwar mutawazi hon to woh mil kar pi molecular orbitals banate hain. Bonding orbitals pi 2py aur pi 2pz ki nuclear mehwar par electron density sifar hai, jo nodal plane hai, jabke antibonding pi* 2py aur pi* 2pz ki nuclei ke darmiyani ilaqe mein sab se kam electron density hai.

blocks.alt: Chhe hisse, lobes par + aur - nishan. 2py - 2py se antibonding pi2p*, chaar lobes aur dotted node; 2py + 2py se bonding pi2p, ek badal oopar (+) aur ek neeche (-). 2pz - 2pz se antibonding pi2p*; 2pz + 2pz se bonding pi2p. 2px + 2px se antibonding sigma*2p, nuclei ke darmiyan node; 2px - 2px se bonding sigma2p, nuclei ke darmiyan ek bara + hissa.
blocks.caption: Figure 3.35: px, py aur pz orbitals se sigma aur pi MOs ka banna (kitab ki Figure 3.35 ke mutabiq asal khaaka; chhape caption mein sigma ki jagah delta jaisa nishan hai).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jab overlap hone wale lobes ka nishan ek jaisa ho (+ ke saath +) to bonding orbital banta hai: electron density nuclei ke darmiyan. Jab nishan mukhalif hon to antibonding orbital banta hai: darmiyan mein node (dotted lakeer) jahan electron density sifar hai. Sire se sire (px) overlap sigma deta hai aur pehlu se (py, pz) overlap pi.

blocks.prompt: Do atomic orbitals mil kar theek do molecular orbitals dete hain. Dono bayan karein, aur batayein ke bonding pi orbital ke electrons kahan milte hain.
blocks.explanation: Ek bonding orbital hai, jo ek jaise nishan ke lobes ke overlap se banta hai; yeh atomic orbitals se energy mein neeche hai aur electron density nuclei ke darmiyan jama karta hai. Doosra antibonding orbital hai, jo mukhalif nishan ke lobes milne se banta hai; yeh energy mein oopar hai aur ek node rakhta hai, density nuclei ke darmiyani ilaqe se door dhakeli hui. Bonding pi orbital mein density nuclear mehwar ke oopar aur neeche hai, jo khud sifar density wali nodal plane hai.

items: MOT: atomic orbitals overlap kar ke poore molecule ke molecular orbitals dete hain; ek jaise nishan ka overlap bonding orbital (sigma, pi, kam energy), mukhalif nishan ka antibonding orbital (sigma*, pi*, zyada energy); bond order = (bonding - antibonding electrons) / 2.
s-s sigma 1s aur sigma* 1s deta hai; seedha p sigma 2px aur sigma* 2px; pehlu se p pi 2py, pi 2pz (mehwar par nodal plane) aur pi* 2py, pi* 2pz.
